verdict.rationale: Mercury docs and community evidence confirm per-card spend limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions are supported and enforced (mercury-docs-10, mercury-comm-1 describes hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits), which is the closest analog to department/program budgets. However, there is no evidence of a distinct 'department budget' or 'program budget' object that aggregates spend across multiple cards/users with automatic enforcement at that rollup level — only individual card-level limits are documented. Missing for 10: dedicated department/program budget objects, rollup spend tracking across a group of cards/users, automatic alerts or hard-stops tied to a budget entity rather than a single card.
